3362.title: Watcher startup recovery and macOS package verification
3362.rootCauseOneLine: The proxy bounds restart delay but never bounds consecutive startup failures; native import failure occurs before ready. The native-package omission was not reproduced in two fresh main builds.
3362.proposedFix: Add a packaging child-start smoke check; define persistent startup failure recovery separately.
3362.caveats: Two fresh main packages started successfully; release omission and UI freeze were not reproduced. Synthetic retry timing; host Node child probe.
